title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

title: Client Onboarding Manager
description:
Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesnât happen behind a desk, and doesnât have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that donât talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

About The Role

The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. This is a customer-facing, hands-on implementation role combining project management, system configuration, payroll-process understanding, customer training and cross-functional coordination.

The Onboarding Manager works closely with customers, in collaboration with the partnerâs Implementation Managers and internal Connecteam teams to ensure employee data, time tracking, PTO, payroll rules and payroll system integrations are configured and validated correctly. The primary goal is to deliver a smooth onboarding experience while ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.

Implementations are payroll-first and planned around the customerâs first clock-in date, payroll schedule and go-live timeline. Depending on account size and complexity, the Onboarding Manager may continue supporting the customer through the first one to three payroll cycles.

Success in this role requires more than technical knowledge. The Onboarding Manager must be highly perceptive, able to read people and situations quickly, and skilled at navigating complex interpersonal dynamics while maintaining trust across multiple internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the customer onboarding process
    • Manage a book of business of customers that came from the partnership, from internal handoff through go-live and initial payroll stabilization.
    • Build implementation plans around first clock-in, payroll periods, training requirements and payroll-processing deadlines.
    • Lead kickoff, setup, training and clientâs payroll.
    • Maintain clear timelines, responsibilities, next steps, risks and customer communication throughout each project.
  • Lead discovery and solution design
    • Understand the customerâs workflows.
    • Translate business requirements into a practical Connecteam setup.
    • Identify complex requirements and suit the right solution with the design of the relevant setup.
  • Configure integrations
    • Configure relevant Connecteam account settings
    • Set up and manage the integration.
  • Deliver training and manage stakeholders
    • Train clients on Connecteam platform and integration process.
    • Train managers on time tracking and payroll workflows using Connecteam.
    • Adapt the training plan to customer size, structure and complexity while keeping sessions practical and process-focused.
    • Work closely with the assigned partner Implementation Manager.
    • Coordinate clearly across customers, partner, Sales, Support, Product, Integrations and leadership.
  • Troubleshoot, escalate and document
    • Investigate issues across the full workflow.
    • Determine issue owner and route it appropriately
    • Escalate payroll-impacting risks with clear documentation
    • Maintain accurate account records, architecture decisions, risks, next steps and handoff documentation.
Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer facing SaaS role with SMB & Mid Market client sizes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and data flows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach when managing complex implementations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, internal teams, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and changing customer needs.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with payroll, HRIS, workforce management, scheduling, time & attendance, or employee management platforms.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, PEO environments, or multi-location/multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience working in a partner-led or channel-based customer environment.

Benefits:

    • Medical, dental, & vision coverage
    • Paid time off for vacation, sick days
    • 401k
Salary: $90K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.

Joining Connecteam Is The Smart Move:

  • We build our people up. Every team member is treated as a long-term investment and we recognize the value in always nurturing and training them so they can go above and beyond in their skills and job duties.
  • We make an impact on our customerâs business. We are on a mission to provide managers of all business types and sizes with the tools they need to communicate, operate, engage, and run their deskless workforce. Our product offers them an effective and affordable solution to run their business.
  • We get the job done. Connecteam employees are passionate in executing their job duties so they can drive the company forward and provide real value to our customers.
  • We have fun! From weekly happy hours to holiday parties, we always enjoy each otherâs company (and good food, of course). Connecteam is like one big, happy family!
  • Everyone is welcome. Connecteam is committed to building an encouraging, caring, and supportive environment. We share a responsibility to support our team and enrich their lives.

title: Join Praemium Expression of Interest
description:
We hire dynamically at Praemium!

At Praemium, we use the Expression of Interest as a way of connecting with people that have an interest in working with us. Candidates simply submit their details to be matched to future role at Praemium.

Whatâs an Expression of Interest?

If we have no specific jobs advertising in the location and area you are interested in working in, you can submit an Expression of Interest, which contains information about you, your job preferences, and your availability. Youâll then be added to our candidate pool, where youâll be considered for opportunities and contacted if a job youâre matched to becomes available. No more scrolling our Careers website regularly to check for new jobs â weâll let you know if you match a job near you!

If you are matched to a job you'll be invited to check out the details and confirm you interest and availability for the job - you'll always have the choice to decline.

Improving your "matchability"

Our system matches candidates based on suitability for a specific job. To maximise your chances of being matched, we suggest when completing the Expression of Interest you consider each question carefully and include the broadest preferences based on what is relevant for you.

Check back on Praemium Careers from time to time

Finally, while we do use the Expression of Interest option, we still advertise roles our current opportunities and rely on this as a central recruitment source. So, itâs worth taking a look at our Careers website from time-to-time.

title: Contents Crew Lead
description:
If you enjoy hands-on work, learning advanced restoration techniques, and mentoring others, this is the role for you. As a Contents Crew Lead (Internally known as Contents Technician II), you'll play a key part in helping people recover what matters most. You'll take pride in restoring items affected by fire, water, and mold while guiding teammates, mastering specialized equipment, and making a real impact on every project.

A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A CONTENTS CREW LEAD

As a Contents Crew Lead, no two days are ever the same. One morning you might be restoring treasured family photos, and by afternoon you could be cleaning specialized equipment or mentoring a new team member. You roll up your sleeves and dive into each job with focus and pride, using advanced tools and cleaning systems to bring belongings back to life. You track and photograph contents, keep meticulous records, and make sure every item is handled with care. You troubleshoot, problem-solve, and stay one step ahead to keep projects on schedule. You take ownership of your work and lead by example, creating a positive, efficient, and safe environment for your team. Every day, your skill, energy, and attention to detail help turn chaos into calm for clients when they need it most.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in restoration, emergency services, or a related field
  • Strong knowledge of cleaning methods for fire, water, and mold restoration
  • Experience operating Ozone and Hydroxyl machines or similar restoration equipment
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and teamwork skills
  • Ability to guide and support Contents Technician I team members
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and comfortable using mobile devices and apps
  • Certifications required: Water Damage Restoration Technician (WRT), Fire and Smoke Restoration Technician (FSRT), and Odor Control Technician (OCT)
  • Additional certifications considered an asset: Commercial Carpet Cleaning (CCT), Carpet Repair and Reinstallation (RRT), Upholstery and Fabric Cleaning (UFT), and Applied Microbial Remediation (AMRT)
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving abstract

Who We Are

At First Onsite, the work you do every day makes a real impact. You'll help communities rebuild and families recover after unexpected events. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health and dental benefits, and RRSP matching because we believe in taking care of our people. You'll have opportunities to learn, grow, and build a lasting career across Canada in a culture that values care, collaboration, and doing the right thing. If you thrive in a team environment and want to make a meaningful difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Executive Operations & Project Manager
description:
Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.


Compensation & Growth

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

  • If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

Full-time Nanny, Camp Hill (40-hours), Commence ASAP!

Hours: MondayâFriday, approx. 40hrs per week (6amâ2pm) | Permanent Full-Time (4-day week may be considered for the right candidate)

Minis: Two boys, 4 & 2, with a baby girl due in November

Commence: ASAP

About Our Clients

This warm and vibrant Camp Hill family are looking for an easy going and friendly Nanny to become a valued part of their home. Dad is a busy business owner, while Mum is a stay-at-home mum preparing to welcome their third mini later this year. They value integrity, accountability and kindness, and have created a positive, respectful home where open communication and mutual appreciation are at the heart of family life.

Their boys are active, curious and full of laughter, enjoying swimming lessons, music, park adventures and playing with monster trucks. The family embraces a healthy lifestyle with limited screen time and loves outdoor play and learning through everyday experiences.

Duties

  • Sole charge of the minis when required
  • Planning fun, engaging outings and activities
  • Taking the minis to swimming, music and other social activities
  • Preparing healthy meals for the minis

  • Driving the minis to activities using the family vehicle
  • Supporting the smooth running of the household during busy mornings


The perfect fit

You're reliable, adaptable and personable, with a genuine passion for supporting young families. You are known to be a nanny who is respectful and not overbearing and follows family routine whilst being confident working independently while respecting the family's routines and parenting style.

All you need is minimum 3-yrs professional childcare and or nanny experience, a valid Blue Card, police check, first aid/CPR certification and a current driver's licence. Most importantly, you'll be someone who builds trust naturally, communicates openly and enjoys creating a calm, fun and nurturing environment where children can thrive.

What's in it for you?

  • Become a genuinely valued and trusted member of a warm family
  • A supportive, respectful workplace where you'll be appreciated
  • Long-term, permanent employment providing stability and consistency
  • A nanny car for your job
  • Competitive salary plus superannuation and full entitlements
  • Opportunity to build meaningful relationships with three wonderful children as the family grows


If you have always dreamed about becoming a professional nanny with a natural gift bonding with children, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Regional General Manager Airports
description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think weâre a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isnât the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

About

For more information about everything WestJet, please visit westjet.com/aboutus.

If you wish to withdraw your application or request that your personal information be deleted, please contact us at talent@westjet.com.

  • Support creator onboarding by updating internal databases, website profiles, onboarding materials, and social media assets.
  • Assist with proactive creator pitching for paid brand partnerships.
  • Support talent scouting initiatives and maintain the agency's talent scouting database.
  • Research new creators, emerging trends, and partnership opportunities.

  • Coordinate meetings, calendars, and scheduling with creators, brands, vendors, and internal team members.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture notes, and distribute follow-up action items.
  • Maintain internal databases, presentations, production trackers, reporting dashboards, and operational documents.
  • Research and source brand contacts across beauty, fashion, travel, hospitality, wellness, food & beverage, and lifestyle industries using Apollo, Airtable, LinkedIn, and additional research tools.
  • Support day-to-day agency operations and assist with special projects as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 1â3 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, events, talent management, PR, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong creative eye for branding, design, and social content.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:


The ideal candidate is creative, resourceful, highly organized, and excited to help build meaningful experiences for creators and brand partners. They enjoy bringing ideas to life, solving problems, collaborating across teams, and staying on top of emerging social and cultural trends. They are equally comfortable planning an event, editing a Reel, coordinating logistics, mentoring interns, or supporting creator partnershipsâalways with a positive attitude and strong attention to detail.

title: A Book of Your Own
description:
Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission.

It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you.

I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes.

It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages.

There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips

Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book.

Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own?

Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject?

Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book.

Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book.

title: This IS Your Dream Job
description:
Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday?

The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing.

Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job

The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment.

Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job

STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand

STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. If you loved laying out the college newspaper, but hated the organizational aspects such as chasing people down to get their content in on time, then that tells you something about the types of activities that work for you.

STEP 3: Envision your ideal job â and list the tasks that it would encompass. What basic skills involved in your ideal job could start working on today? This could be something simple â if your ideal job is to be in charge of all written communication for your organization, an area you could start working on immediately is your writing skills. Even if your current writing skills are pretty good, there is always room to work towards a higher level of achievement.

STEP 4: Now take the list of tasks and activities from steps 1 & 2 above, along with the list of skills from step 3, and group them into functions related to your job that you could concentrate on. (For example, if you are a financial analyst, but you find the grind of financial reports tedious, but you love creating charts and graphs and putting together presentations that visually demonstrate trends â your tasks and activities list could include âcreating graphs & chartsâ, and one skill that could be on your list is âEnhance MS Excel charting & graphing skillsâ.

STEP 5: Conduct some research into the training available out there that would help you to enhance the skills you outlined in step 3. This could involve a number of options â anything from volunteering with an organization in a capacity where you could practice your skills, to taking webinars, intensive workshops, certificate programs, or working toward a degree.

STEP 6: Using the information you gathered in step 5 above, get started with the training program(s) that will meet your individual needs. Remember that you can start small and fine-tune your training plan as you go along. You can also mix and match various training components â it doesnât have to be a straight path, as long as it gets you to where you want to go. Get involved with online forums and interest groups that will help you learn more about the latest techniques in your area of interest. As you spend more time learning and practicing, your skills will improve.

Never underestimate the value of volunteering without asking for additional compensationâ¦your boss and superiors will be impressed that you are interested enough to take on a project without asking for something in return. Showcase your best efforts by volunteering to work on projects that will give you a chance to demonstrate your expertise.

Land Mines to Avoid

Being your own worst enemy â downplaying your talents wonât get you noticed or into consideration for that great new project. Toot your own horn and let others know that you are good at xyz (in the example above, creating charts and graphs). Just as important, offer to help others with that task â soon you will become the resident expert, the one that others turn to for help and advice on this topic

Being finished with learning â remember learning doesnât stop because you have that framed diploma. Keep taking courses, attending seminars and staying in touch with others in your field so that you stay at the leading edge of knowledge and practice in your area of interest

Getting stuck in a rut â Sometimes it seems easier to lay low and just plod along. But you canât stay still â keep looking for new opportunities to apply your talents and showcase them in new and interesting ways.

Decide what you like (and what you donât), do your homework, work hard at new opportunities and advertise the resultsâbefore you know it, youâll be living your dream job.

Contributor: Julie Clarke, Vancouver Island University (www.pr.viu.ca/techcomm)

description:
Supply Chain & Operations Specialist - Join Us at Miss Amara!

If youâre a natural problem-solver who loves keeping things moving in a fast-paced e-commerce world, this role is for you.

As our Supply Chain & Operations Specialist, youâll be the driving force ensuring our DTC and B2B orders are delivered smoothly and on time. By tackling fulfillment bottlenecks with your amazing attention to detail, you'll directly protect our brand trust and keep our customers smiling!

About The Role

Youâll be the heart of our daily outbound operations! You will coordinate dispatch, manage inventory and returns, and keep our logistics dashboards up to date.

Working closely with our logistics partners and CX team, youâll ensure everything flows beautifully. Weâd love for you to bring fresh ideas! Youâll have the freedom to spot process gaps, streamline manual tasks, and help us scale our operations as we grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Order Management: Process and manage DTC and B2B orders across all channels, ensuring accurate statuses and seamless fulfillment across our systems.
  • Logistics Coordination: Work directly with warehouse teams and freight carriers to manage dispatch and swiftly resolve any booking issues or pickup delays.
  • Issue Resolution: Act as the primary go-to for Operations escalations, communicating directly with marketplaces to resolve order issues, delays, and fulfillment bottlenecks.
  • Inventory & Returns: Handle day-to-day inventory tasks, including returns, stock adjustments, and reconciliations in collaboration with our Ops and CX teams.
  • Stock Integrity: Monitor inventory levels closely, proactively flagging any discrepancies or stock mismatches between Cin7, the WMS, and our marketplace channels.
  • Inbound Support: Provide secondary backup for inbound logistics, assisting with shipping bookings and pre-shipment supplier coordination when needed.
  • Process Improvement: Identify operational gaps and implement fresh efficiencies to streamline daily tasks, bringing proactive solutions to recurring issues.
  • Projects & SOPs: Help document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and support the rollout, process mapping, and testing of new tools and supply chain improvements.

What Will Help You Succeed You'll Likely Bring

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced e-commerce business, specifically dealing with order management, administrative tasks, data entry, and document management.
  • Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional teams and partnering with a diverse group of people.
  • A proactive approach to completing tasks, solving problems, and leading initiatives.
  • Proficiency in using Google Sheets and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with Cin7, MS Excel, and Gmail is a strong advantage. General experience with any order management system, freight booking platforms, or supplier/vendor platforms is highly beneficial.

About Us

At Miss Amara, weâre reimagining the rug-buying experience through bold innovation, industry-first tech, and a customer-obsessed mindset. title: Data Engineer / Data Scientist (m/f/x)
description:
Data Engineer / Data Scientist (m/f/x)

Targomo is transforming how companies understand locations, markets, and customers through powerful location intelligence. Our technology empowers retailers, hospitality brands, real estate players, and data-driven organizations to make smarter strategic decisions with confidence.

We are looking for a curious and analytical engineer to help drive our data products forward, with a focus on our footfall data products. You will work on challenging data engineering and data science problems involving large-scale geospatial datasets, designing robust processing pipelines while also contributing to the design and evolution of the data products themselves.

This is a role for someone who enjoys understanding complex systems, thinking critically about trade-offs, and building solutions that are both technically sound and maintainable. Rather than simply implementing predefined tasks, you will be expected to investigate problems, challenge assumptions, and develop thoughtful solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive the end-to-end development and maintenance of our footfall data products.
  • Design, build, and improve scalable data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and processing large datasets.
  • Work on data product design, evaluating methodologies, data quality, and analytical approaches to improve our products.
  • Analyze complex technical problems and develop efficient, maintainable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve existing processes.
  • Ensure data processing workflows are reliable through testing, monitoring, logging, and error handling.
  • Build reproducible data processing systems with clear documentation and data lineage.

What You Bring

You're likely a great fit if you have...

  • A solid foundation in Computer Science through a degree or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Strong Python skills, with excellent knowledge of pandas and writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • A deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, computational complexity, and performance optimization.
  • The ability to think critically about large-scale data processing, selecting the right tools and algorithms for datasets of varying sizes and computational constraints.
  • A curious mindset: you enjoy exploring unfamiliar technical challenges and aren't afraid to dig deep until you understand how things work.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail and quality.
  • The confidence to take ownership, work independently, and drive complex technical projects from idea to implementation.

Bonus points if you also have...

  • Experience working with geospatial data or GIS tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS.
  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks - Dask experience is particularly valuable.
  • Experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience using containerization technologies such as Docker or Podman.
  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure and modern data engineering best practices.
  • Experience communicating directly with clients, translating technical concepts into clear, actionable insights and confidently managing expectations.

Who Will Enjoy This Role?

This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys solving difficult technical problems rather than applying standard solutions. Many of the challenges involve balancing correctness, scalability, performance, and maintainability across complex datasets and processing pipelines.

The technologies we use can be learned. What matters most is the ability to think rigorously, ask good questions, and continuously push for improving the systems and solutions we work with.

Why You’ll Love Working at Targomo

  • The opportunity to shape the future of location intelligence;
  • Hybrid working model (2-3 times a week in the office) with a vibrant Berlin rooftop office;
  • Company stock options plan;
  • 30 days of paid annual leave;
  • And wait there is more - We work in a trusting and collaborative but also fast-paced, innovative tech environment. And we offer competitive salaries.

Ready to apply?

If you’re excited about using AI and data to guide smarter business decisions and want to grow your career in a dynamic and supportive environment we’d love to get to know you and please send us your CV in English!

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Introduction

Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?

Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.

Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit.

Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir.

What's in it for me

  • Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead.
  • Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
  • Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren.
  • Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
  • Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.

How you can make an impact

  • Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen.
  • Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen.
  • Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen.
  • Content & Kreation: Du entwickelst Formate und Inhalte, die bei unseren Zielgruppen ankommen, und testest kontinuierlich, was wirklich performt - datenbasiert statt Bauchgefühl.
  • Marketing-Infrastruktur: Du baust eine skalierbare Infrastruktur auf - von HubSpot-Automation über Lead-Tracking bis hin zu verlässlichem Reporting.
  • KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt aktiv KI-Tools, um Prozesse zu automatisieren - von der Content-Produktion bis hin zu personalisierten Kampagnen.
  • Agentur-Steuerung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Marketing-Agentur, briefst Kampagnen, gibst Feedback und stellst sicher, dass Ergebnisse geliefert werden.
  • Sales-Marketing-Alignment: Du bist die aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb und stellst sicher, dass Leads nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden.

Skills to be successful

  • Erste echte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise im B2B SaaS-, Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur betreut, sondern eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und bist damit auch mal auf die Nase gefallen. Beides ist wertvoll.
  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Abschluss einer Top-Universität oder mit überdurchschnittlichen Noten in Marketing, BWL, Kommunikation o. ä.
  • Performance-Marketing-Kompetenz: Du kennst dich mit Paid Media auf Google und LinkedIn aus, weißt wie man Kampagnen aufsetzt, optimiert und bewertet. Längere Sales-Cycles und komplexe Buying Center sind dir nicht fremd.
  • Zahlenaffinität: Bei uns wird alles gemessen und getrackt. Du scheust dich nicht vor Dashboards und KPIs, sondern nutzt sie als Kompass für deine tägliche Arbeit. Zahlen sind für dich die Basis jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht.
  • HubSpot & Automation: Erfahrung mit HubSpot Marketing Hub - idealerweise inkl. Segmentierung, Automation und Attribution - ist ein klares Plus.
  • KI-Affinität: Du hast Berührungspunkte mit KI-gestützten Tools in der Content-Produktion oder Lead-Generierung und bist neugierig, das weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Kreatives Auge: Du hast ein Gespür für Sprache und Design - für LinkedIn-Posts genauso wie für Kampagnen-Creatives. Erfahrung mit Canva oder Adobe Creative Cloud ist ein Plus.
  • Extreme Ownership: Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist. Wenn du eine Chance siehst, ergreifst du sie. Wenn Hindernisse kommen, überspringst du sie. Du gehst voran.
  • Kommunikation & Kollaboration: Du kommunizierst klar und präzise - intern wie extern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

title: Event Content Creator (m/w/d)
description:
Werde Mammutmarsch Event Content Creator für deine Region!

Wir suchen Menschen, die mit ihrem Smartphone Momente festhalten können, die andere fühlen. Wir suchen keine klassischen Videografen. Wir suchen keine Videoprofis.

Wir suchen Menschen, die den Moment erkennen, wenn sich zwei Freunde nach 100 Kilometern in die Arme fallen. Die sehen, wenn jemand kurz vor dem Ziel mit den Tränen kämpft. Die verstehen, dass oft nicht die perfekte Kamera zählt, sondern der richtige Augenblick.

Wenn du genau dieses Gespür hast, dann suchen wir dich!

Aufgaben

Als Mammutmarsch Event Content Creator begleitest du ausgewählte Events in deiner Region und hältst die emotionalsten Momente des Tages fest – ausschließlich mit deinem Smartphone.

Dabei geht es nicht um perfekte Imagefilme oder cineastische Aufnahmen. Wir suchen Menschen mit einem Auge für echte Momente und der Fähigkeit, diese mit ihrer Handykamera authentisch einzufangen.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Geschichten.
  • Du holst das Beste aus deiner Smartphone-Kamera heraus.
  • Du interessierst dich für Social Media und authentischen Content.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstständig.
  • Du hast keine Scheu, auf Menschen zuzugehen und sie zu filmen.
  • Du hast Lust, langfristig Teil des Mammutmarsch-Teams zu sein.

Benefits

  • Echte Momente voller Gänsehaut.
  • Eine flexible, aber langfristige Zusammenarbeit.
  • Faire Bezahlung für deinen Einsatz rund um das Event.
  • Zusammenarbeit als Freelancer oder mit einer geringfügigen Beschäftigung möglich.
  • Spannende Events und einzigartige Geschichten.
  • Klare Briefings und feste Prozesse.
  • Die Möglichkeit, „deine“ Mammutmarsch-Region langfristig zu begleiten.
  • Ein hochmotiviertes Team hinter den Kulissen und beim Event

Schick uns bitte folgende Informationen:

1. Stell dich kurz vor.

  • Wer bist du?
  • Warum möchtest du Mammutmarsch als Content Creator begleiten?
  • Warum bist du überzeugt, dass du es schaffst, guten Content für uns zu erstellen?

2. Welche Region möchtest du übernehmen?

Teile uns mit, in welcher Region du für Mammutmarsch als Content Creator tätig sein möchtest.

3. Welche zwei Mammutmarsch-Events könntest du pro Jahr zuverlässig begleiten?

Nenne uns die beiden Events, die du langfristig übernehmen möchtest.

4. Deine Bewerbungsaufgabe

Zeig uns nicht dein Portfolio. Zeig uns dein Gespür.

Filme mit deinem Smartphone einen kurzen Clip (30–60 Sekunden), der bei anderen Menschen ein Gefühl auslöst.

Das kann etwas Lustiges, Berührendes, Überraschendes, Unangenehmes oder einfach ein besonderer Moment zwischen Menschen sein.

Wir möchten sehen, ob du die Momente erkennst, die anderen vielleicht entgehen. Außerdem interessiert uns, wie du deine Kamera einsetzt, um diese Geschichte zu erzählen.

Wichtig: Wenn möglich, filme einen echten, ungeplanten Moment. Wir möchten keine gescripteten Szenen sehen, sondern erleben, wie gut du authentische Situationen beobachtest und festhältst.

Lade das Video hoch und sende uns den Link (z.B. WeTransfer) gemeinsam mit deiner Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören und dein Video zu sehen!

Dein Mammutmarsch Team

title: Head of Client & Expert Success (m/w/d) - Account Director
description:
Du hast digitale Projekte und/ oder Teams jahrelang von der Agenturseite oder Unternehmensseite gesteuert – und willst jetzt auf die andere Seite: die richtigen Menschen und die richtigen Projekte zusammenbringen, statt selbst im Delivery zu stecken? Dann ist das hier deine Rolle.

Head of Expert & Client Success

Vollzeit · München und Umgebung + Remote in DE · ab September 2026

Kurz zu uns:

DYGITIZED® ist kein klassischer Personalvermittler und auch keine Plattform.

Wir sind ein kuratiertes Boutique-Netzwerk aus 800+ handverlesenen Digital-Expert:innen, die wir über unser SMTC-Assessment (Skillset, Mindset, Toolset, Cultural Fit) im Rücken, mit Mittelstand, Hidden Champions und Growth-E-Commerce Playern im DACH-Raum zusammenbringen.

Der Unterschied zu allen anderen: Bei uns sprechen Kund:innen und Freelancer:innen mit Menschen, die digitale Projekte selbst gemacht haben – fachlich auf Augenhöhe, nicht mit Vermittler-Floskeln. Genau deshalb suchen wir dich.

Wichtig vorab – für wen diese Rolle ist (und für wen nicht)

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn du aus dem Account Management / der Account Direction oder Projekt Management einer Digital- oder Transformationsagentur oder eine Digitalberatung kommst und Lust hast, dein Projekt- und Rollenverständnis in eine Matching- & Customer/ Freelancer Success-Rolle zu übersetzen.

Diese Rolle ist nicht die richtige, wenn du aus dem klassischen Personalvermittlung- oder aus dem Staffing/ Recruiting kommst. Wir suchen bewusst keine Recruiting-Profile – sondern echte Digital-Insider:innen, die die Arbeit verstehen, weil sie sie selbst verantwortet haben.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle & deine Aufgaben

1. Expert Success & Pool-Qualität

Neue Freelancer:innen fachlich onboarden und richtig einschätzen – du erkennst, ob jemand wirklich auf dem Level ist, das unsere Kund:innen erwarten.

Die Qualität des Pools aktiv sichern und weiterentwickeln – Feedback-Schleifen, SMTC®-Bewertung, gezielte Erweiterung mit Top-Expert:innen.

Beziehungen zu unseren Expert:innen pflegen – du bist ihr verlässlicher Counterpart über ihre gesamte Zeit bei und mit uns, nicht nur Ansprechpartner:in bei Bedarf.

2. Matching & Projekt-Briefings

Kundenprojekte in all ihren fachlichen Facetten durchdringen und die passenden Expert:innen matchen.

Freelancer:innen so briefen, dass sie im Kennenlerngespräch mit Kund:innen souverän und vorbereitet auftreten.

Profilunterlagen für Kund:innen erstellen und aufbereiten, Empfehlungen geben – auf den Punkt, überzeugend, kein CV-Weiterleiten, sondern fachlich und menschlich einordnend.

3. Client Success & Account-Betreuung

Regelmäßige Check-ins bei laufenden Projekten – auf Kunden- und Freelancer-Seite.

Du bist das Frühwarnsystem: Du merkst, wenn ein Projekt kippt, bevor es zum Problem wird.

Du holst Feedback ein: Testimonials, Case Studies und Success Stories generieren und aufbereiten.

4. Business Development

Bestandskund:innen auf Augenhöhe weiterentwickeln – Upselling und Cross-Selling durch Hilfbereitschaft und Besser machen wollen, nicht durch Sales-Druck.

Opportunities in laufenden Accounts selbst erkennen und angehen.

5. AI-gestütztes Arbeiten & Prozesse

Abläufe kontinuierlich hinterfragen und besser machen – Matching, Onboarding und Success schlanker, schneller, reibungsloser gestalten.

KI-Tools und Automatisierungen (z.B. Zapier, MCP, Matching-Agents) gezielt einsetzen, um Routine zu reduzieren und mehr Zeit für Menschen zu schaffen.

KI aktiv im Alltag nutzen – für Recherche, Profil-Aufbereitung, Briefings und Pool-Analyse.

Mitdenken bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-gestützten Matching-Logik (DYGITIZED® AI). Du programmierst nichts – aber du erkennst, wo KI echte Hebel schafft.

Qualifikation

  • Digitale Fachtiefe: Du verstehst, worüber du sprichst – Marketing, UX/Design, Content, Development, AI, Data, Strategy. Du kannst mit Spezialist:innen fachlich mithalten.
  • Empathie & soziale Intelligenz (das Herz der Rolle): Du liest Menschen – zwischen den Zeilen, in Gesprächen, in dem was nicht gesagt wird. Du spürst, was Kund:innen und Freelancer:innen wirklich brauchen, gehst auf Menschen zu und baust echte Beziehungen auf. Kein Tool und keine KI ersetzt dieses Gespür – es ist der Kern dessen, was ein gutes Match von einem passenden Lebenslauf unterscheidet.

  • AI-First-Mindset: Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools, denkst in automatisierbaren Prozessen und hast Lust, unsere Matching- und Outreach-Workflows mitzugestalten. Kein Coding nötig – aber ein Gespür dafür, wo KI Hebel schafft.​

  • Organisierte Power: Du behältst auch in turbulenten Phasen den Überblick und kennst alle Projekte wie deine Westentasche.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, Gespür für Mittelstand, Hidden Champions und etablierte eCommerce-Player

Benefits

  • The Real Deal: Wir sind selbst Digital Natives und wissen, wie gute Projekte gemacht werden – nicht nur auf dem Papier. Und wir bauen aktiv an AI-gestütztem Matching (DYGITIZED® AI)

  • Kein Rädchen: Keine Bullshit-Hierarchien. Du bist nicht Mitarbeiter:in 375, sondern eine zentrale Schlüsselrolle direkt an der Seite des Gründers.

title: Senior Product Analyst (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst (m/f/d) to be the analytical backbone of our Customer Experience stream in the demand division: one person, broad influence. You own how we understand our customers as they move through the Flix journey, and you turn that understanding into the opportunities the stream acts on. Product Owners and CX stream leadership rely on your read of where customers progress, where they drop, and where the value is.
This is a role with a lot of whitespace. The analytics practice in CX is early and the tooling is still settling, so you will have real room to shape how product analytics works here rather than slotting into a finished machine. That suits someone pragmatic and assertive who wants the impact that comes with defining something, not someone who needs a fully built environment on day one.

About the Role

  • Map and quantify how customers move through the Flix journey end to end: where they progress, where they stall, where they drop, and what those patterns mean for the business. This is the spine of the role and the thing only you will own
  • Identify and size the opportunities that fall out of that picture; turn "here is what customers do" into "here is where we should act and what it is worth," and bring those recommendations to product leadership with a clear point of view
  • Set the analytics direction for the stream: define the metrics that matter, decide what good measurement looks like, and go deep yourself on the select topics where depth changes the answer
  • Design, implement, and analyze A/B tests and experiments with statistical rigor, and frame the trade-offs so a Product Owner can make the call
  • Build a self-service analytics environment for CX so product teams can answer their own questions: curated, trustworthy, documented data they can use without going through you for every number
  • Coach Product Owners to make better decisions. Success is not that you ran every analysis; it is that the people around you make sharper, better-evidenced calls, increasingly without you in the room

About You

  • Proven track record influencing product and business decisions through quantitative analysis in a high-growth e-commerce, consumer tech, SaaS, or mobility environment. Comfortable owning a recommendation, not just presenting options
  • Strong customer journey and funnel analytics: activation, conversion, retention, drop-off, and the behaviour behind them across 45+ markets
  • Advanced SQL in Snowflake; confident with at least one Business Intelligence and visualisation tool, e.g. Power BI
  • Strong statistical literacy (hypothesis testing, A/B and quasi-experimental design) and experience reading a result honestly. Pragmatic about rigour, not academic about it
  • Ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate high-quality value delivery, treating it as a force multiplier rather than a novelty
  • Strong stakeholder enablement instincts: able to make data trustworthy, documented, and genuinely self-serve for product and business partners, not just analysts, including contributing to semantic layer and metric definitions alongside Data and Product. Able to carry an executive audience
  • Familiarity with product analytics platforms (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel) is a plus; we are likely to invest here and you would help shape how we use it. Exposure to conversational AI analytics is a plus
  • A pragmatic operator who wants to make an impact, not a researcher who wants a clean problem. Assertiveness is required: you will hold a view, push product teams, and bring order to a forming practice. A doctorate or heavily academic profile is not what we are looking for
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energised by building something that is not fully formed yet
  • Fluent in English; autonomous, entrepreneurial, hands-on; comfortable in a fast-paced, agile, multicultural environment

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads.

  • Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour.

  • Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction).

  • Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack.

  • Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects.

  • Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval.

  • Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing.

  • Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware.

title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the end-to-end development and validation of battery state observers, estimators, and predictors for SoF, SoC, SoH, SoP, SoE, and SoB across cell, cell-bank, and pack level

  • Parameterize multi-RC equivalent-circuit models (OCV, R0, RC pairs, hysteresis, thermal, and aging effects) from cell supplier data, virtual and physical test benches, and HiL rigs

  • Design, implement, and validate estimation algorithms such as Kalman filters (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and data-driven/ML methods, while respecting the certification limitations of ML-based approaches

  • Develop mission-aware predictors that ingest flight-profile and navigation data to predict SoF until safe landing, and compute the energy margin, the predicted surplus SoF at destination, and the SoF trend presented to the crew, updating on diversion, altitude, speed, and ambient changes

  • Develop aging and degradation models and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, and validate the SoH algorithm against the applicable end-of-life criteria across representative mission and durability profiles

  • Ensure the algorithms align with ED-289 requirements for state observers and predictors and ED-309 methodologies for energy level information to the crew, and are consistent with the “Manage Energy” functional breakdown

  • Ensure the algorithms meet functional-safety expectations for a DAL B function: deterministic and bounded execution time, reproducibility, uncertainty bounds on outputs, plausibility checks, built-in test, and malfunction and fault detection

  • Derive, document, and trace algorithm requirements from ED-289/ED-309 and system-level functional analysis, and maintain traceability into the real-time battery management software specification using a model-based design approach

  • Support the real-time embedded realization of estimators and predictors on the pack, lane, and central control units (fixed-point implementation, Simulink code generation, MISRA C) and validate them on HiL setups

  • Define the test and analysis strategy for virtual and physical battery test benches and HiL rigs, and analyze cell, cell-bank, and pack-level data to evaluate algorithm accuracy, stability, and robustness across temperature, aging, and usage variability

  • Set the standard for documentation of methods, assumptions, and validation results

  • Lead collaboration with cell engineering, BMS software, test, HV/LV electrical systems, and certification teams

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Control Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of professional experience in battery state estimation, control systems, or embedded algorithm development

  • Strong command of state estimation and control theory: Kalman filtering (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and system modeling, with an awareness of data-driven and ML methods and their certification constraints

  • Solid battery domain knowledge: lithium-ion electrochemistry, equivalent-circuit and thermal models, aging and degradation mechanisms (capacity fade, resistance growth, lithium plating), OCV hysteresis, and cell-bank-level state granularity

  • Proficiency in Matlab/Simulink and Python, with familiarity with C/C++, fixed-point implementation, Git, and CI/CD
